newsitem.title: CHINA: China to allow overseas listing by 50 state firms.
newsitem.headline: China to allow overseas listing by 50 state firms.

text.p: China will allow 50 of its major state enterprises to be listed on overseas stock markets next year, an official of the cabinet's State Economic and Trade Commission said on Thursday. "It will not necessarily be in Hong Kong," the official said when asked where the state firms would be listed.
"It will be carried out in batches... at an appropriate time next year," the official told Reuters by telephone in reference to the listing. He declined to provide further details.
Hong Kong's Beijing-backed Wen Wei Po newspaper said the planned listing of the 50 state firms would be part of a state enterprise reform package.
"Fifty state firms whose products have markets but which lack funds... will list," the newspaper said. It did not elaborate.
